{{External|rs|rsc=Iron Mace|dw=Iron Mace}} {{Infobox Item |name = Iron mace |image = [[File:Iron mace.png]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wield, Drop |examine = A spiky mace. |value = 63 |weight = 1.814 |respawn = 500 |exchange = Yes |id = 1420 }} [[File:Iron mace detail.png|left|120px]] The '''Iron mace''' is a [[mace]] made of [[iron equipment|iron]]. It is the second weakest mace available in the game. It requires level 1 [[Attack]] to wield, and can be created by using an [[iron bar]] on an anvil (as long as the player has level 17 [[Smithing]]). It can be bought at [[Flynn's Mace Market]] in [[Falador]]. It can be found in the [[Edgeville jail]] and in a house to the east of the [[Ardougne market]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = +4 |aslash = -2 |acrush = +9 |amagic = 0 |arange = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = 0 |str = +7 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = +1 |slot = weapon |speed = 4 |attackrange = 1 |combatstyle = Spiked |image = [[File:Iron mace equipped male.png|130px]] |altimage = [[File:Iron mace equipped female.png|140px]] }} {{CombatStyles|Spiked|speed=4|attackrange=1}} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 17 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 25 |members = No |ticks = 5 |tools = Hammer |facilities = Anvil |mat1 = Iron bar |output1 = Iron mace }} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Iron mace}} ===Spawns=== {{ItemSpawnTableHead}} {{ItemSpawnLine|name=Iron mace|location=[[East Ardougne]] marketplace|members=Yes|2675,3299|leagueRegion = Kandarin}} {{ItemSpawnLine|name=Iron mace|location=[[Edgeville]] - jailhouse|members=No|3111,3517|leagueRegion = Misthalin}} {{ItemSpawnLine|name=Iron mace|location=[[Spike's Spikes]] shop in [[Outer Fortis]]|members=Yes|1776,3060|leagueRegion = Varlamore}} {{ItemSpawnTableBottom}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Iron mace}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 21 April 2021 |update = Fishing Trawler Improvements and Equipment Rebalance: Part One |change = The mace's [[attack speed]] has been decreased from 5 (every 3.0 seconds) to 4 (every 2.4 seconds). }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Iron mace detail (beta).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Iron mace detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Iron mace (beta).png|center]] |[[File:Iron mace.png|center]] |- |RuneScape 2
